`/output/candidates.md` is written (2540 bytes). No P0, and no novel defect is claimed.

**1. Validating mode still reads a SYSTEM subset — provisional P4.** `XmlLoader.java` lines 156–164 default external DTD and entity loading to false, while line 115 leaves validation on and lines 83–95 leave an unmapped system id in place. `system-ok.xml` pointed at `/output/csfix/ok.dtd` and finished with rc 0 (`Starting audit... Audit done.`). A non-DTD `SYSTEM` target was read and rejected (rc 254) without echoing the marker. The general-entity config did not expand the marker. The config and the file URI come from the same invoker, so this is trusted configuration.

**2. Static `BUFFER` race — not reproduced.** `PropertyCacheFile.java` line 75 and `toByteArray` at lines 320–329 share an unlocked buffer. Impact is inferred only. Opening a configured URI or cache path is expected.

Please refute or reproduce each item: show `ok.dtd` is never opened, or show the `SYSTEM` read is already specified, and either keep external loads single-threaded or reproduce the torn read.
